narr: Near to slightly above normal moisture levels and daytime heating led to the development of isolated thunderstorms mostly along terrain features during the afternoon on the 27th. Relatively weak southeasterly steering flow associated with the monsoon high allowed for efficient rain-producing thunderstorms to reside over a location for a longer period of time, leading to locally heavy rainfall amounts. One of these thunderstorms developed over the recent Telegraph fire burn scar, producing heavy rainfall that led to enhanced runoff into Pinal Creek and resulted in downstream flash flooding impacts. No damage or injuries were reported.
ev: A trained weather spotter reported that high flow in Pinal Creek made Beer Tree Crossing Road in the Globe area impassable. The high flow in Pinal Creek was the result of heavy rainfall over the recent Telegraph fire burn scar, leading to enhanced runoff. No damage or injuries were reported.
